positions.explanation: H-pawn promotes with a checking move. h7 checks the king on g8, forcing a flight before promotion. Reference continuation: h6h7 g8g7 h7h8q. Defendant alternative: e3d4 a3a2 h6h7. ...Kg7 leaves g8, and h8=Q+ checks along the diagonal to g7. Assessment at this instructional endpoint: The queen must still deal with Black's distant a-pawn; this is not an automatic mate. Specific common error: Ignoring the black a-pawn after promotion is a common race error. Outcome guidance: promotion gives an apparent practical winning chance, not a tablebase-certified result. Endgame method: A pawn race is decided by exact promotion tempi, legal checks, enemy king proximity and what newly promoted queens attack. Apply the square-of-the-pawn idea while remembering the first double-step and any promotion-with-check exception. After each promotion, inspect whether the opponent is in check before assuming it can promote immediately.
